### 2026-10-24 – Getting more GPIO pins for the octave keys

**4h**

Getting more GPIO pins for the octave keys

I genuinely spend 1.5 hours looking through waveshare's website looking for a board that could give me the 5 extra GPIO pins I need as i'm attempting to make my keyboard an 12 key keyboard. I hope it can fit in the 100x100 board lol. I actually did find the esp32 s3 tiny, but there were just zero footprints online for it for cad. I decided to hop onto a huddle and Signh helped me out by showing me how to route a MCP23017 instead.  And then we decided it's easier to just draw out the footprint for the esp32 s3 tiny  😭. Just finished up the custom footprints for the keyboard and the S3 tiny, took 2 hours figuring out the measurements. I also finished up the symbols for them as well which took about 30 mins.

### 2026-10-25 – Finished PCB!

**1h**

Finished PCB!

This hour, i was able to finish up my pcb and add some extra copper and silkscreen graphics to go along with it!! I had some trouble figuring out how to get the copper to show. Turns out i was doing everything right, but I was supposed to set it to the front variant of the layer while i was setting it to the back mask layer.

### 2026-10-25 – BOM Complete!

**1h**

BOM Complete!

This hour, I completed my entire BOM. I at first wanted to see if i was able to get it from sources other than aliexpress. Turns out I could and still be under budget!
